measurement_method: Separate fresh child per engine/task/mode. Timings: whole task including Parquet read, transformations, final materialization; exclude imports, CSV conversion, verification, output writing, process startup. Each query re-reads Parquet; one or more warmups precede timing. Memory: separate fresh child per engine/task, 10-ms sampled Python RSS over warmup plus one execution, including retained allocator memory. Host OS filesystem cache is NOT flushed.
limitations: Benchmarks run on one laptop and on a warm OS file cache, not cold disk
pandas groupby and Polars lazy query have different execution models
PyArrow Parquet read may use multiple threads; pandas groupby is a baseline
CPU affinity, thermal throttling and background Windows load are not controlled
RSS samples can miss short spikes and include retained memory; not heap allocation
No Spark result or cluster extrapolation is warranted from this step alone
